newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Health accepts 3.96 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Health accepts 3.96 mln shares.

text.p: Magellan Health Services Inc said Thursday about 3.96 million shares have been tendered and accepted for purchase at $18.375 each, according to a preliminary count by the depository for the company's Dutch auction self-tender offer.
On September 5, Magellan increased the tender offer to 3.3 million shares of common stock from 1.89 million.
"We received more tenders than we had anticipated and decided to purchase those as well," said Magellan spokesman Joel Weiden.
Weiden said the company may return about 1,000 tenders that came in above the company's price range or were otherwise improperly tendered.
The company said the tender offer began August 15 and expired at midnight September 18.
